text: Let’s explore nature dataset. looks like visualizing trials.  ’s facet trial:  can now see issue: trials collected continuous clock like align common time (.e., trials start zero). align_trials comes handy:  ’s another example. code: ggplot(wombats,         aes(x=seconds,             y = wombat,             behaviour = behaviour,            color=behaviour)) +   geom_ethogram()  #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. ggplot(wombats,         aes(x=seconds,             y = wombat,             behaviour = behaviour,            color = behaviour)) +   geom_ethogram() +   facet_wrap(~trial) #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. ggplot(wombats,         aes(x=seconds,             y = wombat,             behaviour = behaviour,            color = behaviour)) +   geom_ethogram(align_trials=TRUE) +   facet_wrap(~trial) #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. ggplot(wombats,         aes(x=seconds,             y = trial,             behaviour = behaviour,            color = behaviour)) +     geom_ethogram() +     facet_wrap(~wombat) #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. ggplot(wombats,         aes(x=seconds,             y = trial,             behaviour = behaviour,            color = behaviour)) +     geom_ethogram(align_trials = T) +     facet_wrap(~wombat) #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5. #> ℹ No observation interval provided, using guessed interval 5.

title: ggplot2 extension to plot ethograms
text: two supported workflows: geom_ethogram() computes ethogram segments (quick start). compute_*() lets precompute segments debugging analysis.

title: ggplot2 extension to plot ethograms
text: ethogram_demo small deterministic dataset designed make outputs easy verify.
code: ggplot(ethogram_demo,        aes(x = seconds, y = subject, behaviour = behaviour, colour = behaviour)) +   geom_ethogram() +   facet_wrap(~ trial)

title: ggplot2 extension to plot ethograms
text: precompute segments, geom_ethogram(stat = "identity") draw without recomputing. computed data keeps original column names adds *_end columns plus mapping metadata.
code: seg <- compute_samples(ethogram_demo,                        x = seconds,                        y = subject,                        behaviour = behaviour,                        interval = 5)  ggplot() +   geom_ethogram(data = seg, aes(colour = behaviour), stat = "identity")

title: ggplot2 extension to plot ethograms
text: wombats larger, variable dataset multiple trials.
code: ggplot(wombats, aes(x = seconds, y = wombat, behaviour = behaviour, color = behaviour)) +   geom_ethogram() +   facet_wrap(~ trial) ggplot(wombats, aes(x = seconds, y = wombat, behaviour = behaviour, color = behaviour)) +   geom_ethogram(align_trials = TRUE) +   facet_wrap(~ trial)

title: Compute Ethogram from Intervals — compute_intervals
text: Intervals mode strict time columns: `x` `xend` must numeric datetime (POSIXct/Date/difftime). `x` `xend` must complete (missing non-finite values). `xend < x` error; `xend == x` emits warning.

title: Compute Ethogram from Samples — compute_samples
text: data data frame. x Column name sample times. y Column name y axis. behaviour Column name behaviour labels. group Column name grouping (optional). colour Column name colour (optional). interval Fixed interval samples (optional). interval_mode Use `"explicit"` require interval `"guess"` infer. remove_nas Remove rows `NA` behaviour values.

title: Compute Ethogram from Samples — compute_samples
text: Samples mode enforces time consistency: `x` must numeric datetime (POSIXct/Date/difftime). `x` must complete (missing non-finite values). `x` must monotonic within group; time reversals errors. Duplicate `x` values emit warning (zero-length segments). `interval_mode = "explicit"` requires finite `interval > 0`.

Changing generate ethograms. position Position adjustment, either string, result call position adjustment function. ... arguments passed [ggplot2::layer()]. often aesthetics, used set aesthetic fixed value, like colour = "red" size = 3. may also parameters paired geom/stat. size Line size.
